lead_fa: Mistweaver یک هیلی میله‌ای پرسرعت است که شفای مستقیم و HoT را با آسیب‌دادن فعال ترکیب می‌کند؛ با [[Renewing Mist]] و [[Enveloping Mist]] و Mana Tea بازی می‌کنی. دو مسیر Hero Tree داری: [[Conduit of the Celestials]] با احضار چهار آسمان‌تمند و [[Master of Harmony]] با هماهنگی روح و تن.

strengths: Melee focus: certain mechanics never target you, giving higher uptime
Large, flexible cooldown set matching various damage patterns
Highly mobile healer for quick mechanics and repositioning
Low barrier to entry: several aspects play for you if you keep abilities on cooldown
Active cooldowns enhance gameplay past set-and-forget variants
weaknesses: Unpreparedness for group damage leads to a catch-up spiral
Weaving casts and melee abilities is daunting for players unfamiliar with melee
Spending too much mana is easy: track your mana and sip Mana Tea consistently

hero.recommendation: Both trees are viable and stylized; Conduit of the Celestials calls the four August Celestials through Tiger Palm/Vivify (Courage of the White Tiger), Thunder Focus Tea (Heart of the Jade Serpent), and Sheilun's Gift; Master of Harmony focuses on being in tune with body and spirit.
hero.conduit_of_the_celestials: Raid emphasis: cooldown reduction from Heart of the Jade Serpent, high Renewing Mist uptime extended by Rushing Wind Kick via Rising Mist, and responding to Strength of the Black Ox procs into Vivify.
hero.master_of_harmony: Harmony-focused variant with its own defensive interplay.

builds.codes_source: Wowhead 'Best Mistweaver Monk Talent Builds' page (wowhead.com/guide/classes/monk/mistweaver/talent-builds-pve-healer), export strings captured verbatim via the page's Copy buttons on 2026-10-27; do not modify.

concepts: Juggle quick-cooling spells and capitalize on generated Renewing Mists, healing through them via Invigorating Mist.
Never overcap Mana Tea stacks: your mana sustains the encounter's throughput.
Consume Spiritfont stacks before they overcap.

raid_priority: Vivify to keep someone alive who would otherwise die without your intervention
If you have 2 Spiritfont stacks, consume at least one to avoid overcapping
Vivify with high Renewing Mist coverage and an injured raid
Consume Spiritfont procs with an injured raid
Enveloping Mist with a Strength of the Black Ox proc
Mana Tea if you have any stacks
Blackout Kick, or Tiger Palm if on cooldown (keeping the damaging weave going)
rotation.cooldowns: Revival and Restoral are the big raid cooldowns; Life Cocoon for tank emergencies; Thunder Focus Tea should almost always be on cooldown, empowered for the situation at hand.

gear.gearing_rules: Intellect >> Haste > Crit > Versatility >> Mastery for Raid; Intellect >> Haste > Mastery > Crit > Versatility for M+ (same for both hero trees). At final BiS aim for 0 Mastery; some is fine while gearing for ilvl. Use QE Live for upgrades.

Crit synergizes with Mana Tea's additional stack chance.

mplus.hero_note: Conduit of the Celestials carries the Best tags in M+; the playstyle rewards weaving melee into healing.
tips: Renewing Mist on cooldown during the gather; Invigorating Mist converts them into instant healing.
Mana Tea discipline is the skill check: sip before it overcaps so the next pull is funded.
Roll/Tiger's Lust/Transcendence solve most movement mechanics faster than any other healer.
